properties.otherAdvice:
Large crowds are expected to attend the annual 5-day Parkes Elvis Festival from Wednesday 8 January to Sunday 12 January. The following roads will be closed to accommodate crowds:

From 6am Wednesday to 8pm Sunday - Short St will be closed from Clarinda St to Welcome St.

From 6am Friday 12 Jan to 7am Sunday 14 Jan - Sections of Clarinda St, Church St and Court St will be closed.

From 6am Saturday to midday Sunday - Sections of Bushman St, Victoria St, and Caledonia St will be closed to facilitate the Elvis Street Parade.

Motorists should allow extra travel time, be aware of increased pedestrian movement and follow instructions of traffic controllers diverting traffic around closures
properties.diversions: The closure of Short St will see a detour for all vehicles via Lachlan St, May St and East St

A-League Men: Sydney FC v Perth Glory at Allianz Stadium. Kick-off at 7pm, finish around 8.45pm.

Traffic may be heavier than usual on roads approaching Moore Park as fans travel to the match. Allow extra travel time on roads including the Eastern Distributor, Moore Park Rd, Cleveland St, Anzac Pde and Lang Rd.

  • Driver Ave will be partially closed outside the stadium before the match from 5pm and will reopen once crowds have safely cleared the area after the game.
  • No through-traffic will be available on Driver Ave, however access to EP3 grass car park and drop-off areas will be maintained from Lang Rd.
  • EP2 Kippax car park will not be open for this match.

Special event clearways will be in effect on roads in Moore Park and surrounding areas from 6am until 10pm including sections of Cleveland St and Fitzroy St, and from 3pm to 10pm on sections of Albion St and Moore Park Rd.

Clearways are strict no-parking zones for all vehicle types, and apply even to local residents and TfNSW Mobility Scheme Permit holders. Check signs carefully as vehicles left in clearways will be towed and a fee applies. If your vehicle is towed, you can search your vehicle registration at the Find My Car website to find its new location, or alternatively call 132 701 to speak to an operator.

  • BBL: Sydney Sixers v Perth Scorchers. Gates open at 3.15pm. Start of play at 4.45pm, end of play at approx. 7.40pm.
  • A-League Men: Sydney FC v Central Coast Mariners. Gates open at 6.30pm. Kick-off at 7.35pm, full time around 9.20pm.

Traffic will be heavy on roads in and approaching Moore Park as fans travel to and from the precinct throughout the afternoon and evening.

Motorists should allow extra travel time on roads including the Eastern Distributor, Moore Park Rd, Cleveland St, Anzac Pde, Oxford St and Lang Rd.

Changed traffic conditions:

  • Driver Ave will be partially closed outside the stadiums from 2.15pm and will reopen after crowds have cleared the area.
  • No through-traffic will be available on Driver Avenue, however access to EP2 Kippax car park will be maintained via Moore Park Road and access to EP3 grass car park and drop-off areas maintained from Lang Road. Car parks will open from 1.45pm.
  • A-League fans are reminded that parking is expected to be full with cricket fans. Carpool with your group and have a back-up plan for parking.  
  • Special event clearways will be in place on roads in Moore Park and surrounding areas from 1pm to 10pm on sections of Albion Street, Fitzroy Street and Moore Park Road, and from 6am to 10pm on Cleveland Street.  

Clearways are strict no-parking zones for all vehicle types and apply even to local residents and TfNSW Mobility Scheme Permit holders. Check signs carefully as vehicles left in clearways will be towed and a fee applies. If your vehicle is towed, you can search your vehicle registration at the Find My Car website to find its new location, or alternatively call 132 701 to speak to an operator.

properties.otherAdvice:
The Royal National Park is expected to be busy over the Christmas and New Year holiday period between 21 Dec and 3 Feb.

Visitors are encouraged to check the Royal National Park local alerts before travelling for updates on precinct access.

Walking trails may also be closed due to total fire bans and/or risks, so plan ahead. 

Roads or carparks may close within the Royal National Park when they reach capacity.

The following locations may be affected:

  • Wattamolla Beach carpark
  • Bonnie Vale day use area
  • Audley Valley
  • Wattamolla Rd between Sir Bertram Stevens Dr and Wattamolla Beach carpark
  • Maianbar Rd between Bundeena Dr and Maianbar township
  • Bundeena Dr between Sir Bertram Stevens Dr and Bundeena township

Garie Road is closed between Sir Bertram Stevens Drive and Garie Beach - Garie Road long term closure.
